purpose: Implement the first bounded CORE-04 trust primitive: exact material action preview/fingerprinting plus explicit approval binding to that exact fingerprint, with stale invalidation on every material change and no execution capability.

lineage.outcome: The artist can inspect one exact action representation and an explicit approval can bind only to that exact revision/payload/target/destination/purpose fingerprint, becoming stale after any material change.
lineage.capability: Exact-revision action preview and stale-approval invalidation

legacy_candidates: exact-revision approval semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: preview exposes all material action fields plus a stable SHA-256 intent fingerprint
explicit bind_approval requires a non-empty caller-supplied approval source reference and binds exactly to the current intent fingerprint
an unchanged intent validates the approval as VALID
changing action ID, job, action class, description, target, revision fingerprint, payload fingerprint, destination, purpose or data categories makes the prior approval STALE
data-category ordering/duplicates canonicalize without changing the material fingerprint
an outbound destination requires an explicit purpose and blank approval source is rejected
local actions may omit destination/purpose without gaining execution authority
AuthorityService public API contains preview, bind_approval and validate only, with no execute/send/post/publish/mutate/charge path
preview and validation are deterministic and pure with no persistence or side effect
approval binding proves only exact explicit approval representation and grants no provider/host permission
next_selection_rule: After CORE-04A evidence, reconcile and globally compare the next authority/transaction/private-egress contract against preserved CORE-02 Success Memory. Do not add an executor merely because approval binding now exists.
